summary: A generated TypeScript file that tells the type checker about built-in Next.js types. It should not be edited by hand.
purpose: Lets TypeScript understand Next.js features such as image imports and generated route types.
why: The file's own comment says not to edit it, and Next.js creates it.
how: Adds references to the Next.js type definitions and imports two generated type files from the build output folder.
inputs: Generated type files written into the build output folder.
outputs: No runtime output. It only affects type checking.
risks: It imports from the build output folder, so it fails if that folder is missing. Any manual edit is overwritten when Next.js regenerates it.
debug: If type errors mention missing routes or types, run the Next.js dev or build command so the generated folder is recreated.
